ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: Late in the daily cycle (day 28 of ~36-42) — odds favor a dip into the next cycle low from here even with the trend intact.
ladder.next: Let the next daily cycle low form before adding; watch for the swing-low setup.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 28).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Stretched/late — protect gains and don't start new positions; let the next low set up first.
entry.text_zh: 已拉伸／晚期——保护利润，不要新开仓；先等下一个低点构筑成形。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 28 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: approaching the window where lows usually form
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 28 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 接近低点通常形成的时间窗口
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 处于日线周期晚期（约 36-42 天中的第 28 天）——即便趋势完好，从此处概率上仍倾向于回落至下一个周期低点。
ladder.next_zh: 在加仓前先让下一个日线周期低点形成；留意摆动低点形态。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 28 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A HIGH signal just triggered today (fresh cross from UPTREND). Signal strength: faint (score -10/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近高点信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自上涨趋势翻转）。 信号强度：微弱（评分 -10/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: light exit setting up (-24)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱离场构筑中（-24）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

Long per-name cone is thin/under-powered — defer to the sector cone.

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha

headline.en: Short-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate tailwind.
headline.zh: 短久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率顺风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.32 ± 0.11 — high precision. Sector anchor (XLF) reads short-duration (-0.11). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.32 ± 0.11——精度高。 板块锚（XLF）为短久期（-0.11）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
